particulars.description: The freehold property known as the laurels and pines lodge, 33 and 35 to 37 (odd) foxholes road, poole BH15 3NA with title number: DT101632.

Among other charges as are more particularly described in the charging instrument, the properties known as 33 and 35 to 37 (odd) foxholes road, poole BH15 3NA with hmlr title number DT101632 and malden house, 69 sidford road, sidmouth EX10 9LR with title number DN139577, together with:. (A) all estates and interests in freehold, leasehold and other immovable property (wherever situated) now or in the future belonging to the company, or in which the company has an interest at any time;. (B) all buildings and fixtures (including trade fixtures) and fixed plant and machinery at any time thereon;. (C) all easements, rights and agreements in respect thereof; and. (D) the benefit of all covenants given in respect thereof..
